prediction_text: Prediction: Hillary Clinton wins the 2016 US presidential election. The forecasting panel's consensus, aligned with the polling lead Clinton holds through October, favours the Democrat; no chart feature supplied in the material overturns the favourite. Decided 8 November 2016 (unit: day; election day fixed by the question).

Material as given: an international astrology conference election panel (Costa Mesa, October 2016); most polls favour Clinton. Method note: this seat follows the panel-consensus reading that the source presents — the panel's collective judgement is the master signal for this card, and no contrary chart datum is supplied in the card to set against it (fact-priority: only card-carried facts may be used; none supplied for the other side). Timing: day scale (single-day event). R61-REV1-2: primary path = panel consensus; second path = polling-favourite corroboration; both point to Clinton, single coordinate retained. R61-REV1-4: winner-only claim, no sub-claims to grade.
